scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Construction/ Purchase of Wooden/ FRP Fishing Vessel (Canoe) for Fishermen
other_conditions: The applicant must be a traditional fisherman by birth or profession.
The applicant must be a resident of Goa.
The applicant or any household member must not be a defaulter with the Directorate of Fisheries, Goa.
The purchased canoe must be registered with the Directorate of Fisheries under the Marine Fishing Regulation Act 1980 / Merchant Shipping Act.
The applicant shall not sell, lease, mortgage, or transfer the craft for 5 years from the date of purchase.
The craft must be used exclusively for fishing purposes only.
Only one subsidy grant is allowed per family household once every four years.
benefits_summary: 50% subsidy on the fishing vessel, capped at ₹60,000 for general applicants and ₹80,000 for SC/ST applicants.
documents_required: Prescribed format of the application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
